title: Rounding the Arrears Settlement Figure Quoted on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
How the arrears settlement figure quoted to a member is rounded follows the routes money has already come onto their crop input account by.

**Clause.** Where a payment made by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds stands on the account over the 10 statement months before the handling date, the figure is taken up to the next whole hundred dollars at or above the net figure. Where no payment made by that route stands on the account over those months and a payment made by check stands on it over those months, the figure is taken up to the next whole ten dollars at or above the net figure. In every other case the figure is rounded no further on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Payments by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds over the 10 statement months | Payments by check over those months | The figure quoted |
| --- | --- | --- |
| one or more | any | Taken up to the next whole hundred dollars at or above the net figure |
| none | one or more | Taken up to the next whole ten dollars at or above the net figure |
| none | none | Rounded no further |

**What taking a figure up to a whole step means.** The whole step is 100 dollars where the figure is taken up to the next whole hundred and 10 dollars where it is taken up to the next whole ten. A net figure already standing on a whole step is left where it stands; otherwise it is carried to the whole step next above it. The step is taken to a tolerance of 0.999999 of one step, so a figure standing within a millionth of a step below a whole step counts as standing on it.

*Hypothetical reading.* A net figure of 4312.40 USD on an account carrying a payment by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds is quoted at 4400.00 USD; a net figure of 4400.00 USD is quoted at 4400.00 USD. The same 4312.40 USD on an account carrying only payments by check is quoted at 4320.00 USD.
